name: manual_7de08a
claim: Never reconstruct a large tracked file from displayed or truncated tool output; use raw Git/blob/file transport or explicit byte-offset manifests, then verify final byte count and content hash.

decisions.notes: Remote-agent output can be excerpted, wrapped, capped, or marked truncated. The PR #388 incident arc showed that per-step success does not prove reconstructed bytes; authoritative raw transport plus final size/hash checks are required.
